generation.scope: No standard regular indexed algebra has exactly one reduced decomposable relation in the four-edge scheme. All projection dimensions and opposite ranks are covered. Independently of the size of the pure locus, a cycle of four two-line corridors with one center per phase and direction is impossible.

open_mathematics: Classify the first remaining finite pure schemes (length two, including one double point) by tracking shared eigenlines, excess contact and allowed endpoint pairings; analyze positive-dimensional pure schemes and stable finite-point candidates.
